manifest.name: dsh-baidu-netdisk
manifest.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service.

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Connect DeepSeek Harness to [Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service](https://github.com/baidu-netdisk/mcp). This community plugin registers the service's SSE tools in DSH. Each user authorizes their own Baidu account.

1. Install in the DSH profile you use. Replace `desktop` with your profile name if needed.

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:justinzyc271828-sys/dsh-baidu-netdisk
   ```

2. Open the [official authorization guide](https://github.com/baidu-netdisk/mcp#使用准备) and follow the account authorization steps. The individual-account application is a limited trial. Baidu may change its availability or credentials.
3. Run the local prompt below. Copy the complete address of the official Baidu success page into the hidden prompt, then press Enter. A new authorization replaces the previous one. Restart the DSH profile and ask it to check your Baidu Netdisk capacity.

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
   $dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
   node (Join-Path $dshRoot 'profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-baidu-netdisk/src/auth.js')
   ```

macOS/Linux:

```sh
   node "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-baidu-netdisk/src/auth.js"
   ```

The helper requires Node.js 22 or later. It saves the token under `~/.dsh-baidu-netdisk/`. Windows encrypts it with user-scoped DPAPI. On macOS and Linux, the helper creates the directory and token file with user-only permissions. You can set `DSH_BAIDU_NETDISK_CREDENTIAL_DIR` in both processes to choose a different private directory. Never paste the token or success URL into an agent chat or a profile file. Revoke access via [Baidu's account authorization page](https://passport.baidu.com/v6/appAuthority).
The plugin filters the tools advertised by the official service. As of 2026-11-02, it discovered 13 tools by default and 23 with writes enabled. Tools use the `mcp__baidu_netdisk__` prefix.

| Mode | Capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| Default | List files by type, get metadata and content, search by keyword or meaning, read account and quota, inspect share contents, verify share codes, and check share task status |
| With writes enabled | Create folders and documents, copy, move, rename, create shares, transfer shared files, and request upload by URL or text |

The optional `file_upload` tool produces a draft for Baidu's separate `bdpan` CLI. The plugin does not install or run that CLI. Use Baidu's own instructions for local-file uploads. The tools exposed to an account depend on Baidu's authorization and service responses.

To enable write tools, set `enableWrites` for this plugin in DSH, or apply this profile patch and restart:

```yaml
- id: baidu-netdisk
  config:
    enableWrites: true
```
DSH prompts for approval on each write call. Profiles without an approval channel deny the call.

readme.section: DeepSeek Harness 百度网盘插件
readme.text:
[English](README.md)

把[百度网盘官方 MCP](https://github.com/baidu-netdisk/mcp) 接入 DeepSeek Harness。每位用户自行授权百度账号。安装后可用自然语言查询网盘容量、列目录、按文件名或语义搜索，并读取文件信息和内容。

1. 安装到正在使用的 DSH 配置。下例用 `desktop`，使用其他配置时请替换名称。

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:justinzyc271828-sys/dsh-baidu-netdisk
   ```

2. 按[百度官方授权说明](https://github.com/baidu-netdisk/mcp#使用准备)登录并授权。官方个人账号入口属于限时体验，百度可能调整可用性或凭据。
3. 运行下方命令。在隐藏输入提示里粘贴百度授权成功页的完整地址，按回车。重新授权会替换本地凭据。重启 DSH 配置后，可以问「查一下我的百度网盘容量」。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
   $dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
   node (Join-Path $dshRoot 'profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-baidu-netdisk/src/auth.js')
   ```

macOS/Linux：

```sh
   node "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-baidu-netdisk/src/auth.js"
   ```

授权命令需要 Node.js 22 或以上。令牌保存在 `~/.dsh-baidu-netdisk/`。Windows 用当前用户的 DPAPI 加密，macOS 和 Linux 用文件权限限制访问。若要使用其他私有目录，可为授权助手与 DSH 进程设置同一个 `DSH_BAIDU_NETDISK_CREDENTIAL_DIR`。请勿把令牌或授权成功页地址发到聊天里，也不要写入配置文件。可在[百度账号授权管理](https://passport.baidu.com/v6/appAuthority)撤销授权。

截至 2026-11-02，实测默认加载 13 个查询工具，开启写入后发现全部 23 个工具。默认模式支持按类型列文件、查询元数据和内容、关键词及语义搜索、查询账号与容量，以及查看分享内容、校验提取码和查询分享任务状态。

需要创建目录、复制、移动、重命名、分享、转存或上传时，在 DSH 中开启插件的 `enableWrites`，或为配置加入下列补丁并重启。DSH 会为每次写入请求确认。没有审批通道的配置会拒绝写入。

```yaml
- id: baidu-netdisk
  config:
    enableWrites: true
```

官方 `file_upload` 只生成 `bdpan` CLI 上传草稿。实际上传本地文件需要单独按百度官方说明安装并登录 `bdpan`。本插件直接转发百度提供的文本、URL 上传工具，具体可用性受账号授权和服务限制。
